title: Pricing Generalized Dispersion Swap for Multi-Asset Stochastic Volatility Models
abstract: arXiv:2510.20047v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper develops a generalized variance framework for pricing multi-asset dispersion swap based on the determinant of the instantaneous covariance matrix of asset log-returns. This determinant-based measure captures the joint dispersion of multivariate asset returns while accounting for their dependence structure. We formulate the proposed framework under the Heston and Barndorff-Nielsen-Shephard (BNS) stochastic volatility models, deriving an analytical pricing expression for the three-asset Heston formulation and a tractable approximation for the corresponding BNS formulation. To assess the empirical performance of the proposed approach, we conduct numerical experiments using nine stocks obtained through the quantmod package, randomly partitioned into three groups of three assets. The models are calibrated and evaluated against empirical generalized realized variance across selected time horizons.

translated_title: 基于多资产随机波动率模型的广义离差互换定价
translated_abstract: 本文基于资产对数收益率的瞬时协方差矩阵的行列式，开发了一个用于多资产离差互换定价的广义方差框架。这种基于行列式的度量方法能够捕捉多元资产收益的联合离散度，同时考虑其依赖结构。我们在Heston和Barndorff-Nielsen-Shephard (BNS)随机波动率模型下构建了所提出的框架，推导了三资产Heston模型的解析定价表达式以及相应BNS模型的可处理近似。为评估所提方法的实证表现，我们使用通过quantmod软件包获取的九只股票进行数值实验，将其随机划分为三组，每组三只资产。模型在选定的时间区间内基于经验广义已实现方差进行校准和评估。
tldr: 本文提出基于资产对数收益率瞬时协方差矩阵行列式的广义方差框架来定价多资产离差互换，在Heston模型下推导出解析定价表达式、在BNS模型下给出可处理近似，并通过九只股票的实证数值实验验证了方法的有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a generalized variance framework for pricing multi-asset dispersion swaps based on the determinant of the instantaneous covariance matrix of asset log-returns, deriving an analytical pricing expression under the three-asset Heston model and a tractable approximation under the BNS model, with empirical validation through numerical experiments on nine stocks.
